findings.article_1: Amends overall upper-secondary educational plan: History compulsory; Informatics among nine elective subjects, students choose four. Informatics 70 periods/year/class; elective specialization clusters separate. Also amends social-science educational orientation.
findings.article_2: Amends History subject curriculum with attached History curriculum.
findings.article_3: Effective 03 August 2022; signature/seal visible on page 3.

tin_scope_conclusion: Relevant to overall subject selection/timetable. Articles 1-3 do not replace Informatics subject outcomes or prescribe per-question cognitive labels. Do not use the History appendix as Informatics curriculum.
limitations: Only instrument pages 1-3 visually reviewed; History appendix pages 4-68 not reviewed and not required to claim Informatics-specific outcomes. Other amendment applicability remains separately tracked.
